Some material is **preserved but not publicly served** — because the licence or a rights-holder's permission is still pending, or because publishing it could expose people. Examples include certain full site captures (WACZ) and media such as archived recordings. You can ask about access here, and we will tell you what is and isn't possible.

**Which item?**

**Who are you, and what is the intended use?**
<!-- researcher / journalist / family member / institution; and what you'd do with it. This helps us weigh rights-holder and safety constraints. -->

**Is this for preservation, research, or republication?**
<!-- republication usually needs the rights-holder's permission, which we may not yet have -->

**Acknowledgements**
- [ ] I understand access may be refused or limited where the licence or permission isn't in place
- [ ] I will not re-publish material whose rights are not cleared
